crossRefs.note: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this…
I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son…
When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of…
They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters…
You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter…

parallels.note: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter…

translations.web: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
translations.bsb: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.
translations.kjv: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters
translations.asv: And make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
